div.div:
Container partition key: /id (hashed scope tuple).
Separate histories per provider; at most 20 exchanges each.
Logical exchange expiry: 24 hours; physical TTL is eventual.
ETag-conditional writes; 120-second lease, renewed every 10s.
Bounded duplicate window: up to 256 activity IDs / 24 hours.
Reset invalidates the lease and clears app-held histories.
No in-memory fallback; not indefinite exactly-once delivery.

text.tspan: Separate histories per provider; at most 20 exchanges each.
Logical exchange expiry: 24 hours; physical TTL is eventual.
Bounded duplicate window: up to 256 activity IDs / 24 hours.
Reset invalidates the lease and clears app-held histories.
No in-memory fallback; not indefinite exactly-once delivery.
